params.body:
Restack of #361 (`workbench/fix/platform-copy-count`) on the one-file-per-finding layout. **Merge order: #368, #369, #370 (the layout), #374, #384, #379, #385, then this one.** The gateway pushes each PR as a snapshot of its own files on top of main, so this diff shows only this PR's files.

Same change as #361, with one difference: the finding it added as X-127 is a file in `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/`: `2026-09-15-platformkopie-telling-en-kopieerknop.md` (opgelost). The rule text of R S1-10.2 and R S2-1.16, `OwnStockController`, `PlatformPhotoService` and `PlatformPhotosOnShareTest` refer to it by slug. R S2-1.17 is new and free on main (S2-1 ends at .16); no rule renumbered.

Checked locally on top of the stack: `RulesIdentityTest`, `RulesDocsBuildTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `PlatformPhotosOnShareTest` (25 tests, 80 assertions, OK). Shane closes the original.
params.title: The platform-copy warning counted wrong and offered no way out (restacked)
